title: Git Modern Command Reference & Internal Architecture
description: High-density Git cheat sheet covering interactive staging, branch rebase workflows, reflog recovery, and visual branch architecture.

sections.title: Core Commands & Staging
sections.description: Staging files, interactive hunk commits, and status checking.

subtopics.title: Interactive Staging & Commits
subtopics.description: Selectively stage hunks and format conventional commits.

table.title: Staging Command Reference
rows: Split mixed edits into focused commits
Remove a file from the next commit
Review what remains outside the index

tabs.label: Quick Reference
tabs.code:
# Interactive hunk staging
git add -p

# Stage all tracked modifications
git add -u

# Commit with inline message
git commit -m "feat: add user authentication flow"

annotations.text: Interactively prompts to stage individual code hunks instead of entire files

callouts.title: Conventional Commits
callouts.text: Use prefixes like feat:, fix:, docs:, refactor:, or test: for automated changelogs.

sections.title: Branching & Interactive Rebase
sections.description: Branch management, rebasing onto main, and interactive squashing.

subtopics.title: Branch Workflows & Interactive Rebase
subtopics.description: Maintain a clean linear git history with interactive rebasing.

diagram.content:
graph TD
  MainBranch["Main Branch: C1 -> C2 -> C3"]
  FeatureBranch["Feature Branch: C2 -> F1 -> F2"]
  RebaseResult["Rebased Linear: C1 -> C2 -> C3 -> F1' -> F2'"]
  MainBranch --> RebaseResult
  FeatureBranch --> RebaseResult

tabs.label: Quick Reference
tabs.code:
# Create and switch to feature branch
git checkout -b feature/login

# Rebase feature branch onto updated main
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main

# Interactive rebase last 4 commits
git rebase -i HEAD~4

annotations.text: Launches interactive editor to pick, reword, squash, or drop commits

callouts.title: Golden Rule of Rebasing
callouts.text: Never rebase a public branch that other team members are actively pulling from.

callouts.title: Autostash On Rebase
callouts.text: Use git rebase --autostash to automatically stash uncommitted changes before rebasing.

callouts.title: Reflog Expiration
callouts.text: Git keeps reflog entries for 90 days before garbage collection runs.

callouts.title: Hard Reset Danger
callouts.text: git reset --hard permanently discards uncommitted working directory changes.
